provenance: Reconstructed finite-range refit control. Original fifth-round code and data were deleted during consolidation; this is not an exact replay of that round.
fit_objective: minimize maximum absolute relative kernel error on training momenta, independently for each background
training: even momentum indices in [0,pi] of retained FFT grid with Nfft=8L
validation: odd momentum indices in [0,pi], excluded from fit
nonlinear_extension: Same squared-density coordinate, RMS background and full gradient as SARC; PCHIP interpolated refitted coefficients
exact_reference: retained JW plus/minus profiles from 24 weak-field groups; no nonuniform density used to fit kernel coefficients
purpose: Test whether refitting a fixed-range kernel can eliminate the leading linear density error. Refit parameters belong only to the control, not SARC.
